change_class: TOOL RENAMED, KEYS REMOVED, VALUES AND TRANSPORT. The tool is served as `get_support_resistance_zones` (was `get_sr_zones`; no alias: the old name is refused as an unknown tool, Mr.1 SR-ZONES-W2 R8). `order` and each zone's `formed_from` / `formed_to` are no longer served (R7), nor is `note` (R8); no key added or re-typed. Zone `low` and `high` are rounded outward to one price step per call, and `distance_pct`, the `price_inside_zone` flag and the summary read those served edges; the tool is publicly listed in Beta; an x402 HTTP route serves it at a flat $0.02 per call.
change_note: Supersedes get-sr-zones-shape-snapshot-2026-11-15.json (SR-ZONES-W1), which describes the tool under its old name. `allowed_keys` drops `order` and `note`, and `zone_keys` drops `formed_from` and `formed_to`; every other key list is unchanged. The served zone is the zone (R7 #3): `low` and `high` are rounded outward, and `distance_pct`, `price_inside_zone` and the summary's range, inside and distance are read from those served edges. Which zones are selected, their order, side, `state`, `broke_at`, touches, `no_zone_above` / `no_zone_below` and `overlaps` are computed on the unrounded zone exactly as before. The served description and tool title end with " (Beta)", from the registry flag.
source: src/tools/get-sr-zones.ts (runGetSrZones) + src/lib/sr-zones/zones.ts (computeSrZones, attachSrZoneOverlaps) + src/lib/sr-zones/summary.ts (the summary template) + src/lib/sr-zones/rounding.ts (the served edges) + src/lib/sr-zones/served.ts (the served frame: the zone allow-list, the distance and the inside flag) + src/lib/adapters/binance.ts (getPriceTick) + src/lib/tool-call-pipeline.ts (the get_support_resistance_zones row); pre-deploy capture, pinned by tests/unit/sr-zones-handler.test.ts + src/lib/x402-http-routes.ts and src/lib/x402-bazaar.ts (POST /x402/get_support_resistance_zones and its Bazaar declaration)
results_note: `summary` is one factual sentence from the template in src/lib/sr-zones/summary.ts; the zone-1 range it prints, whether price is inside that zone and how far it is are read from the served (rounded) edges. `volume_vs_20` is the last closed candle's volume divided by the mean volume of the 20 candles before it, or null. `support` and `resistance` each hold at most 3 zones.
zone_note: `rank` 1 is the zone nearest price on its side; each next rank formed earlier and sits further from price. `distance_pct` is the gap from price to the served zone's near edge in percent of price (2 decimals), 0 when price is inside the served zone; along a side it never decreases with rank (two zones can tie). `last_touch` and `broke_at` are candle open times (ISO 8601, UTC) and may be null. `members` counts the turning points in the zone. `touch_bars_90` counts closed candles among the last 90 whose range meets the zone; `tests_30` counts closed candles among the last 30 that entered the zone and closed back on the side they came from. `low` and `high` are rounded outward (low down, high up) to one step per call: four significant figures of `price` (10^(floor(log10(price)) − 3)), raised to the smallest multiple of the venue's price tick at or above that when the tick is known. Each served zone contains the computed one, and each edge moves by less than one step.
overlaps_note: One entry per zone of ANOTHER requested timeframe whose price range intersects this zone; `side` is support or resistance. Empty when one timeframe is requested. Overlaps are judged on the unrounded edges.
state_note: A zone turns former_support or former_resistance after 2 consecutive closes through it with price now on the other side; `broke_at` is the open time of the candle whose close was the second, else null.
flags_note: `no_zone_above` / `no_zone_below`: no zone was found on that side in the candle history read; `price_inside_zone`: price is inside at least one listed zone, judged on the served edges.
algovault_note: `quota` is the caller's meter after this call is billed (buildScanQuotaState); `claim_url` and `claim_hint` appear only for an anonymous session (withAuthState).
billing: MCP quota: per-verdict, one unit per entry in `results`; an unserved timeframe and every refusal are unbilled. x402 (POST /x402/get_support_resistance_zones, or an x402 proof on a /mcp call): $0.02 flat per served call, however many timeframes are served; a refused call is never settled.

error_contract.transport: MCP (tools/call): a refusal is a structured JSON text payload with isError: true. x402 HTTP (POST /x402/get_support_resistance_zones): no payment, or a proof below $0.02 → 402 with the payment requirements; a refusal → the same payload with `status` as the HTTP status, never settled.

invalid input.note: The MCP SDK's input-schema check (strictToolInput, src/index.ts) refuses before the handler runs: a timeframe outside 15m 30m 1h 2h 4h 8h 12h 1d, fewer than one or more than three timeframes, a venue other than BINANCE, or an unknown key. On POST /x402/get_support_resistance_zones the same JSON Schema (the Bazaar declaration) refuses it with 400 X402_HTTP_INVALID_INPUT, before the payment is claimed.

quota_exhausted.note: The scan quota wall (buildScanQuotaWall), as scan_trade_calls and scan_market_regimes render it, checked before any candle read. retry_after_hours (daily wall), recommended_path, referral_hint and suggested_x402 appear only when they apply.

no_timeframe_served.note: 503 when any requested timeframe failed for a reason a retry can change (a venue error, a rate limit, a stale, empty or budget-skipped read, or a full read not finished within 10 s), else 422. `unserved` gives each timeframe's reason.

error_contract.order: input schema → quota wall → candle reads → no_timeframe_served. Nothing is billed unless a timeframe is served; then one unit per served timeframe.

forbidden_keys_note: get_support_resistance_zones reports where price clustered before, as facts. It never emits a trade call, a direction, a win rate, a probability, a target, a strength score or a prediction (the facts-only lint over every emitted string, tests/unit/sr-zones-facts-lint.test.ts). `signal_hash` and `descriptionRef` are internal identifiers; the outcome_* fields are internal.

cache_contract.description: Candle history is cached in process per venue × coin × timeframe until that timeframe's next candle close (at most 256 windows). Inside that candle a read less than 60 s old is served with no venue request; an older one re-reads the newest page (one request: the 100-candle trade_call window), merges it over the cached history and moves `timestamp`; a failed re-read serves the cached window with its older `timestamp`, never as unserved. A window with no candles is never cached. A failed full read is remembered for 20 to 30 s (jittered), during which a repeat call gets the same `unserved` reason with no venue request (at most 1024 remembered). A call waits at most 10 s for a full read: past that, the timeframe is `unserved` for that call (unbilled, not remembered as a failure) while the read finishes in the background, single-flight, and caches its window for the next call. History pages read in Binance's batch weight class; the newest page reads in the interactive class.
cache_contract.client_cache_refresh: an open MCP session sees get_support_resistance_zones after it re-fetches tools/list
cache_contract.price_tick: The venue price tick (Binance exchangeInfo PRICE_FILTER.tickSize) is read once for every coin and cached 24 h, in the batch weight class; a failed or tick-less read is remembered for 60 s. A call waits at most 2 s for it and otherwise serves with the four-significant-figure step.

drift_check_command: curl -fsS -X POST https://api.algovault.com/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/list"}' | sed -n 's/^data: //p' | jq -e '.result.tools[] | select(.name == "get_support_resistance_zones") | .inputSchema | (.properties | has("coin") and has("timeframes") and has("venue")) and .properties.timeframes.maxItems == 3 and .additionalProperties == false' >/dev/null && echo SHAPE_OK
